tenant-continuous-qa-loop.title: Tenant Continuous QA Loop
tenant-continuous-qa-loop.instruction: Run the tenant continuous QA loop: validate build/test health, identify regressions, and queue focused remediation tasks with evidence.

tenant-knowledge-scout-sprint.title: Tenant Knowledge Scout Sprint
tenant-knowledge-scout-sprint.instruction: Run a knowledge scout sprint: collect relevant framework, provider, and operations intelligence, then summarize actionable updates for routing and implementation.

tenant-orchestrator-pulse.title: Tenant Orchestrator Pulse
tenant-orchestrator-pulse.instruction: Run the tenant orchestrator pulse: review active state, route pending work, refresh priorities, and surface blockers requiring Local Director attention.

tenant-loop-watchdog.title: Tenant Loop Watchdog
tenant-loop-watchdog.instruction: Run the tenant loop watchdog: detect stalled loops, stale locks, missing heartbeats, and failed recurring jobs; queue recovery work without destructive actions.

tenant-self-improvement-loop.title: Tenant Self-Improvement Loop
tenant-self-improvement-loop.instruction: Run the tenant self-improvement loop: inspect recent failures and stale proposals, select bounded improvements, and produce implementation-ready tasks.
